// The first meeting. Sets `met_sheriff`, which a rematch file can read.
//
// A two-hander: SHERIFF holds the right side and {PLAYER} the left, so both
// portraits are exercised and the dimming reads.

# opening
MENTOR: Alright, let's go over the basic again.
{PLAYER}: Again? We've been through this a thousand time...
MENTOR: Practice makes perfect.
{PLAYER}: Maybe for you, I already beat you twice, you really want to go down that road again?
MENTOR: Won't happen again this time.
{PLAYER}: If you insist.
MENTOR: First, revision, what's the number one rule?
{PLAYER}: You do not shoot during the [jump]first 10 steps[/jump] Do we really have to go through the theory too?
MENTOR: You shot me on the 9th step <b>that one time</b>
> "I MISCOUNTED!"                               -> tutorial
> "Yeah, sorry about that"(feel sorry)       -> tutorial
> "Yeah, sorry about that"(does not feel sorry)       -> tutorial

#tutorial
MENTOR: Forget it, what do we do during the first 10 steps?
{PLAYER}: We focus on each step, [jump]<color=#d9a441>the more we focus, the more accurate we shoot</color>[/jump] <color=#e8d9a0>(W to focus)</color>
MENTOR: Then?
{PLAYER}: Load the gun. (R to reload)
MENTOR: Then?
{PLAYER}: On the 10th step, it's either winning or dying.
-> END
